package.description: Terminal UI (Textual) for I2PChat over I2P SAM

en-US.description: Terminal UI (Textual) for I2PChat over I2P SAM
en-US.longDescription:
I2PChat TUI is the Textual console client for I2PChat (no PyQt GUI). This winget package uses the
*-winget-* release zip without embedded i2pd; use a system i2pd with SAM or the full TUI zip from GitHub Releases
for a bundled router.
en-US.name: I2PChat TUI
en-US.releaseNotes: v1.5.3: Aligns with I2PChat 1.5.3 (Python Textual TUI; handshake v4, wire-compatible with 1.4.x and 1.5.x). Status opens from the status line; English/Russian switch; optional profile password. Winget *-winget-* zip without embedded i2pd. Full TUI zip with bundled router: I2PChat-windows-tui-x64-v*.zip on GitHub Releases. i2pd: https://github.com/PurpleI2P/i2pd
